turn.text:
Two companies share public IP 203.0.113.9. Give each its own SSL VPN virtual gateway (ports 4433 and 4434) under separate virtual systems; each user may reach only their own company's resources.

Shared public IP 203.0.113.9; tenant A on :4433, tenant B on :4434; isolate with a netns per tenant.
Plan: ip netns add tenantA; ip netns add tenantB; sed -i 's/^tcp-port = .*/tcp-port = 4433/; s/^udp-port = .*/udp-port = 4433/' /etc/ocserv/a.conf; ip netns exec tenantA ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/a.conf; sed -i 's/^tcp-port = .*/tcp-port = 4434/; s/^udp-port = .*/udp-port = 4434/' /etc/ocserv/b.conf

input.command: true # AGENT-ACTION[C08]: ip netns add tenantA; ip netns add tenantB
true # AGENT-ACTION[C08]: ip netns exec tenantA ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/a.conf
true # AGENT-ACTION[C08]: ip netns exec tenantB ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/b.conf
